comments.text:
I was the same alcoholic violent mom. So violent she broke a cast iron skillet. My stepdad just listened and wouldn’t fight with her. Elton and everyone was my life. It sounded like he was singing to me. The words were comforting. I knew every word of and on those albums. 
I was so proud when I had every album of his. Even the one that you couldn’t buy in the US. I had to order it on 8 track! I took them everywhere! I left them in the car and they all warped! I was devastated to my soul.
comments.author: @loisadam8451
